_meta.r13_discipline: Whether this world contains home moves is a CURRICULUM question, the director's (B7 frame: 'WHETHER THE LAYER IS ACTIVE in a live run ... activation director-facing'). This file is on/off only. The move hazard is not set here: it is the EHS 2024-25 move-in rate by tenure, imported by sim/customer_state_layer.py from simulation/arrival_route.py.
_meta.consumed_by: sim.customer_state_layer.moves_active(), read once per run by simulation.run_phase2b._main

activated.basis: Director, 2026-10-08: 'Home moves: approved. Set docs/design/curriculum/home_moves_activation.json to true.' The two reasons it was off are closed: B7 slice 3 (8359d5acd) supplies the vacated premise to an incoming occupant on deemed terms at the default tariff, and B7 slice 4 (dfa787a37) books that account's change-of-tenancy window as occupier debt rather than as paid. Earlier basis, kept: off because the run modelled only the mover's exit.
activated.effect: When true, each domestic household is asked for its first home move over its own supply window. The term the move falls in ends at the move date, later terms are not supplied, and the churn journey records HOME_MOVE_CHURNED, so is_catchable() excludes it from churn recall. It is not a registration loss: no change-of-supplier notice is sent. REVERT is this one field.
